c74object.name: el.vdel~
c74object.digest: Variable delay line with internal LFO modulation and feedback
c74object.description:
el.vdel~ is a variable delay line with feedback designed for flanging, chorus, and vibrato effects. Delay time is modulated by an internal sinusoidal LFO whose rate and depth are controlled by the speed and depth parameters. Connecting an audio signal to the fifth inlet overrides the internal LFO, allowing direct, continuous control of the delay time (ranging from 0.0 to 1.0 relative to the maximum delay). Built-in feedback limiter protection (protect) is enabled by default to prevent numerical overload.
Inlets
Inlet 1 [Left Inlet] (signal): Audio signal input to be delayed, and control message inlet (protect).
Inlet 2 (signal / float): LFO modulation speed in Hertz.
Inlet 3 (signal / float): Modulation depth factor (0.0 to 1.0).
Inlet 4 (signal / float): Feedback gain coefficient (-1.0 to 1.0).
Inlet 5 [Rightmost Inlet] (signal): Direct delay override (0.0 to 1.0). Overrides the internal LFO to control delay time directly.
Outlets
Outlet 1 (signal): Variable delayed audio output signal.

inlet.description: Audio signal to be delayed, as well as the protect command.
Modulation frequency for the internal sinusoidal LFO in Hertz. Accepts float messages or audio-rate signals.
Delay modulation depth scaling factor (0.0 to 1.0). Accepts float messages or audio-rate signals.
Feedback gain coefficient (-1.0 to 1.0). Accepts float messages or audio-rate signals.
Audio-rate signal that overrides the internal LFO and directly controls the normalized delay tap position (0.0 to 1.0 relative to maximum delay).

outlet.description: The processed variable delay audio output signal.

objarg.name: maximum-delay
objarg.description: The maximum delay buffer size in milliseconds (default: 50.0 ms, range: 0.1 to 60,000 ms).

objarg.name: speed
objarg.description: Frequency of the internal modulation oscillator in Hertz (default: 0.1 Hz).

objarg.name: depth
objarg.description: Depth of delay time modulation relative to maximum delay (default: 0.25, range: 0.0 to 1.0).

method.name: float
method.description: Float sent to inlet 2 sets LFO speed in Hz. Float sent to inlet 3 sets modulation depth. Float sent to inlet 4 sets feedback gain.

method.name: protect
method.description: When set to 1 (default), automatically clamps feedback gain within ±0.99 to prevent runaway overflow. When set to 0, feedback limiting is disabled.

method.name: signal
method.description: Signal arriving at inlet 1 is the audio to be delayed. Signals arriving at inlets 2 through 4 continuously modulate LFO speed, depth, and feedback at audio rate. Signal arriving at inlet 5 overrides the LFO to directly control delay position.
